liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Minglewood Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 11 archived performances [21]
- **Playing in the Band reprise**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 12 archived performances [21]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Samson & Delilah, Bertha, Sugaree, Friend of the Devil, Crazy Fingers, Uncle John’s Band, Scarlet Begonias, Fire on the Mountain, Shakedown Street, Dark Star, Wharf Rat, Goin’ Down The Road Feeling Bad and more [21]

## The recordings

- **deadandcompany2015-11-01.schoeps-96-24.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 17 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **dco2015-11-01.4022.5012.stereo192.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 177 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **deadco2015-11-01**: source not stated; 17 songs; 176 min; rated 3.71/5 by 7 [4]
- **DeadCo.11-1-2015MSG**: source not stated; 17 songs; 175 min; rated 3.2/5 by 10 [5]. Said about its sound: The recording is excessively hot, making it difficult to listen to comfortably; The audio file suffers from significant overdriving and distortion, causing listening pain; The recording is too hot; no Tapers Section existed, forcing reliance on cell phones [12][13][14][16]
- **deadco2015-11-01_201511**: source not stated; 17 songs; 176 min [6]

## Around the show

- John Mayer's guitar work and deep connection with the band created a joyful experience [9]
- Bobby led the band with energy, creating an electric atmosphere in the venue [11]
- The crowd swelled with love when Bobby belted out the extra long Searchlight line [15]
- The recording was credited to wrafratjoe for the actual capture of the audio [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadandcompany2015-11-01.schoeps-96-24.flac24**: taped by A. Whitney; transferred by A. Whitney; source: Audience [1]. Also: Recorded in Tapers Section using Schoeps mics, Sonosax preamp, and Zoom H6 recorder [1]
- **dco2015-11-01.4022.5012.stereo192.flac16**: taped by Christopher Jones; transferred by Christopher Jones; source: DPA 4022 Handmatched Compact Cardioid > Rupert Neve Designs Portico 5012-H Microphone Preamplifier (“Silk” circuit engaged) > Mogami XLR Interconnect > Mytek… [3]. Also: Captured FOB using DPA 4022 mics, Rupert Neve preamp, and Sound Devices 722 recorder [3]
- **deadco2015-11-01**: taped by Richie Stankiewicz; source: Dpa 4021>luni V-2>Sound Devices 702>24/96 [4]. Also: Recorded and transferred by Richie Stankiewicz, with set two tracks renamed for order [4]
- **deadco2015-11-01_201511**: Recorded in the Sweet Spot by Richie Stankiewicz using DPA 4021 mics and Sound Devices 702 [6]
